stories.title: Chilly Black Friday; Warmer this weekend

stories.title: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani has surgery for torn Achilles tendon from soccer match injury
stories.summary: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani underwent surgery Friday after tearing his right Achilles tendon last week in a soccer match against local journalists.

stories.title: UN rapporteur Albanese in limbo at airport after being denied entry to Costa Rica
stories.summary: Francesca Albanese, the U.N. special rapporteur on human rights in the occupied Palestinian territories, is stranded at Costa Rica's main airport awaiting for a court to decide whether she could enter the country after immigration authorities blocked her entry.

stories.summary: A man is in custody after a shooting in Oakley, CA killed his wife and injured his teenage stepdaughter in the 500-block of Marathon Drive.

stories.title: Lung cancer survivor urges screenings as awareness month comes to a close
stories.summary: As Lung Cancer Awareness Month ends, health professionals are urging people to get screened.

stories.title: Search underway for pregnant prisoner who escaped in corrections vehicle in New Mexico
stories.summary: The search continues for a pregnant inmate who authorities said escaped while being escorted back to prison in New Mexico.

stories.title: British police link substance release at Don Toliver's recent Manchester concert to robbery attempts
stories.summary: British police say the release of an unknown substance at a Don Toliver concert in Manchester is linked to a group of criminals seeking to rob people at the gig.

stories.title: Mexico files formal complaint to US over DEA tip line for anonymous reports
stories.summary: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum says the country is filing a formal complaint with the U.S. over a Drug Enforcement Agency tip line for anonymous reports about criminals and corrupt Mexican officials.
